title: Tikka Masala Sauce
steps: Sauté the onion over moderately high heat.
Reduce heat and add the dry spices and ginger.
Add tomato paste, purée, chicken stock and lime juice; bring to a boil.
Add coconut milk and reduce to a simmer. The source says the sauce can be refrigerated up to 3 days ahead.
